_readme: Desk Sponsor slot on the dashboard (growth.js). One curated card replaces the programmatic banners. Add a sponsor booked through ads@webdesks.app / the contact form's Advertising topic, then deploy. Fields: id (a-z, 0-9, dashes; used in stats), name, tagline, url (https), cta, logo (an image path such as /sponsors/acme.png, or an emoji), label ('Sponsor' for paid placements, 'Affiliate' for affiliate links — always disclosed on the card), category, desks (which Desk presets see it: all, dev, student, remote), start / end (YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive), weight (rotation share). With no live sponsor the card invites brands to book the slot. Views and clicks are counted per day in Supabase sponsor_stats.

_example.name: Acme Standing Desk
_example.tagline: Sit-stand desk with memory presets. WebDesks readers get 10% off.
